The first item under Old Business was second and final reading of an Ordinance

imposing a temporary moratorium on the establishment of Data Processing Centers for a 2-

year period within Jonesborough’s corporate limits. The purpose of this moratorium is to allow

sufficient time for the Planning Commission, Board of Mayor and Aldermen, and staff to study

and research the land use compatibility, infrastructure impacts, environmental and health

impacts, and broader policy considerations associated with Data Processing Centers. The

BMA passed this ordinance on First Reading on October 13, 2025. Mayor Wolfe asked the

Aldermen if they had any questions or comments. There being none, Alderman Jenkins made

the motion to approve Ordinance imposing a temporary moratorium on the establishment of
